candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has fever for 2 days. The temperature is 38.0°C. The child has had measles within the last 3 months. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. There is no clouding of the cornea. There is no generalized rash. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. This area is a high malaria risk area. Malaria test is available and the result is negative. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, does not have diarrhoea, and does not have ear problem. The child does not have measles cough. The child does not have mouth ulcers. There is no obvious cause of fever found. There is no pus draining from the eye. The eyes are not red. There is no runny nose. There is no stiff neck.
